name: Agent Blueprint
description: Agent Blueprint helps companies decide, one agent at a time, whether an AI agent is worth it: measure its real cost and results against a number set in advance, then keep, fix or stop it (three weeks for an agent already running, day 90 for a new one). A renewal review of every live agent on one platform for $24,000, or one agent for $7,500 (first five design partners half price), delivered by NowGentic, on any platform.

writing a one-page summary, agent card or charter for any agent
